draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.93, the 189th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 9th of 13 at QB. He went 189th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 2,861 passing yards in 2024, 11th of 13 QBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Indianapolis Colts. 5 career games and 1 starts over 1 completed season. Still developing: 2 AV in 2025. Weak spots: approximate value 2 (6th percentile). Played 5 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-1 quarterback who played: 415 passing yards against a median of 1,341, below the norm.
